mechanics.name: The Master and Servant Link
mechanics.desc: Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd.
mechanics.flavor: A Servant's wound is its Master's.

mechanics.name: The Master and Servant Link: A Perfect Link
mechanics.desc: Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. A perfect link: the wounds are split evenly.
mechanics.flavor: A Servant's wound is its Master's.

mechanics.name: The Master and Servant Link: Threshold
mechanics.desc: Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: A Servant's wound is its Master's.

mechanics.name: The Master and Servant Link: Muster

mechanics.flavor: A Servant's wound is its Master's.

mechanics.name: The Master and Servant Link: A Thin Link
mechanics.desc: Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. A thin link: a quarter of each wound is shared.
mechanics.flavor: A Servant's wound is its Master's.

mechanics.name: The Master and Servant Link: Quorum
mechanics.desc: Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. It only wakes when several delvers stand together in the area.
mechanics.flavor: A Servant's wound is its Master's.

mechanics.name: The Master and Servant Link: Anchored
mechanics.desc: Every delver is bound to the nearest ally by a thin line of mana: when one is struck, the other takes half of it. The line makes sense for a pair and nonsense for a crowd. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: A Servant's wound is its Master's.

mechanics.name: The Chain Jail
mechanics.desc: Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts.
mechanics.flavor: The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.

mechanics.name: The Chain Jail: The Drawing Chain
mechanics.desc: Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts. The chain also drags the strayer back.
mechanics.flavor: The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.

mechanics.name: The Chain Jail: Omen
mechanics.desc: Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.

mechanics.name: The Chain Jail: Keystone

mechanics.flavor: The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.

mechanics.name: The Chain Jail: A Short Chain
mechanics.desc: Two delvers are chained together by a conjured chain: if they stray far from each other the chain bites, and the farther they stray the more it hurts. A shorter chain: three blocks of slack.
mechanics.flavor: The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.

mechanics.name: The Chain Jail: Quorum

mechanics.name: The Chain Jail: Switch

mechanics.flavor: The chain only breaks when the one who made it chooses.

mechanics.name: The Revival Window
mechanics.desc: A fallen delver is not dead yet: for twenty seconds they lie in a daze, and any ally who kneels beside them can lift them back up; after that, they log out for good.
mechanics.flavor: Ten seconds, and the healer is out of range.

mechanics.name: The Death Saves
mechanics.desc: When a delver falls they do not die: they roll their saves, a short desperate count in which every wound or kind word matters, and then they either stand or do not.
mechanics.flavor: Three successes, three failures. The dice are not on anyone's side.

mechanics.desc: When a delver falls they do not die: they roll their saves, a short desperate count in which every wound or kind word matters, and then they either stand or do not. A forgiving table: the downed also get a short regeneration.
mechanics.flavor: Three successes, three failures. The dice are not on anyone's side.

mechanics.name: The Party's Pack
mechanics.desc: The party's pack is heavy and shared: the more each member carries, the slower the whole party moves, until somebody puts something down.
mechanics.flavor: Even the hero's party had a pack mule. She was called Fern.

mechanics.name: The Party's Pack: The Shared Burden
mechanics.desc: The party's pack is heavy and shared: the more each member carries, the slower the whole party moves, until somebody puts something down. The burden is split: it takes the whole party's count to slow anyone.
mechanics.flavor: Even the hero's party had a pack mule. She was called Fern.

mechanics.name: The Fallen Comrade's Rage
mechanics.desc: When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards.
mechanics.flavor: We carry them with us. Every one.

mechanics.name: The Fallen Comrade's Rage: Rage and Grief
mechanics.desc: When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards. A grief that mends: part of the strength is a heal.
mechanics.flavor: We carry them with us. Every one.

mechanics.name: The Fallen Comrade's Rage: Wounded
mechanics.desc: When one of the party falls the others do not mourn: they fight harder, faster and wider, for a while, and are not themselves afterwards. It smells a wounded delver and strikes when someone drops under half health.
mechanics.flavor: We carry them with us. Every one.

mechanics.flavor: We carry them with us. Every one.

mechanics.name: The Fallen Comrade's Rage: Backlash

mechanics.name: The Four-Key Door
mechanics.desc: A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands.
mechanics.flavor: Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.

mechanics.name: The Four-Key Door: The Two-Key Door
mechanics.desc: A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands. Two keys only: a smaller party can manage.
mechanics.flavor: Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.

mechanics.name: The Four-Key Door: Omen
mechanics.desc: A vault door with four locks and four keys, each in a different corner of the room: they must be turned at the same moment by four hands. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.

mechanics.name: The Four-Key Door: The Door of Plates

mechanics.name: The Four-Key Door: Quorum

mechanics.name: The Four-Key Door: Sequenced

mechanics.flavor: Two keys is a puzzle. Four keys is a meeting.

mechanics.name: The Bell Test

mechanics.flavor: Those who break the rules are scum, but those who abandon their friends are worse than scum.

mechanics.name: The Spiral Crowd
mechanics.desc: The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not.
mechanics.flavor: Who the hell do you think we are?

mechanics.name: The Spiral Crowd: A Four-Man Spiral
mechanics.desc: The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not. It needs four to fire.
mechanics.flavor: Who the hell do you think we are?

mechanics.name: The Spiral Crowd: Threshold
mechanics.desc: The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Who the hell do you think we are?

mechanics.name: The Spiral Crowd: Anchored

mechanics.flavor: Who the hell do you think we are?

mechanics.name: The Spiral Crowd: The Spiral Heals
mechanics.desc: The more of the squad stand in one spot, the more spiral energy they raise, and the room, which is built on that energy, notices: crowds are fine, but a crowd that cannot move is not. The energy heals as well.
mechanics.flavor: Who the hell do you think we are?

mechanics.name: The Spiral Crowd: Stillness

mechanics.name: The Guild Master's Mark
mechanics.desc: One member of the guild carries the master's mark and is lifted up by it; the rest feel the mark's weight. Whoever bears it leads, whether they like it or not.
mechanics.flavor: A guild master doesn't need to be the strongest. They need to be the most stubborn.

mechanics.name: The Guild Master's Mark: The Mark that Mends
mechanics.desc: One member of the guild carries the master's mark and is lifted up by it; the rest feel the mark's weight. Whoever bears it leads, whether they like it or not. The mark mends its bearer.
mechanics.flavor: A guild master doesn't need to be the strongest. They need to be the most stubborn.

mechanics.name: The Guild Master's Mark: Omen

mechanics.flavor: A guild master doesn't need to be the strongest. They need to be the most stubborn.

mechanics.name: The Guild Master's Mark: Keystone
mechanics.desc: One member of the guild carries the master's mark and is lifted up by it; the rest feel the mark's weight. Whoever bears it leads, whether they like it or not. One marked warden holds it up; slay the keystone to end it.
mechanics.flavor: A guild master doesn't need to be the strongest. They need to be the most stubborn.

mechanics.name: The Guild Master's Mark: The Weighty Mark

mechanics.flavor: A guild master doesn't need to be the strongest. They need to be the most stubborn.

mechanics.name: The Executioner and the Convict
mechanics.desc: Delvers are paired off, convict and executioner, and the pairs are bound by a leash of fear: if either strays too far from the other, both are punished.
mechanics.flavor: Survive together, or be swept aside separately.

mechanics.name: The Soul Resonance
mechanics.desc: Two delvers must act in perfect unison: stand on two pedestals, strike the same note at the same moment, and the doors answer; one lagging half a beat is enough to spoil it.
mechanics.flavor: Our souls are in sync. Don't tell me you can't feel it.
